title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: Look at the columns in the DataFrame. Each column represents a different attribute of the buildings, such as 'id', 'building', 'number', 'college', and 'renovated'.

title: Focus on the 'renovated' Column
text: The 'renovated' column shows the year each building was renovated. Some entries might be missing, indicated by 'None'.

title: Identify the Building with the Most Recent Renovation
text: Which building has the most recent renovation year listed?
